Exercise: Russian Twist

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- rotational

Primary Muscles:

- abdominals

Secondary Muscles:

- lower back

Equipment:

- bodyweight

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
3

Energy Requirement:
aerobic and anaerobic

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- oblique_muscle_development
- core_strength_and_stability

Contraindications:

- Lower back pain (if exacerbating the condition)

Exercise Variations:

- name: Russian Twist with Medicine Ball, equipment: medicine ball
- name: Russian Twist with Dumbbells, equipment: dumbbells

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Bicycle Crunches, equipment: body only
- exercise_name: Seated Cable Twist, equipment: cable machine

Instructions:

- Lie down on the floor placing your feet either under something that will not move or by having a partner hold them. Your legs should be bent at the knees.
- Elevate your upper body so that it creates an imaginary V-shape with your thighs. Your arms should be fully extended in front of you perpendicular to your torso and with the hands clasped. This is the starting position.
- Twist your torso to the right side until your arms are parallel with the floor while breathing out.
- Hold the contraction for a second and move back to the starting position while breathing out. Now move to the opposite side performing the same techniques you applied to the right side.
- Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
